item.title: Major overgrowth still obstructing public footpath – previous report incorrectly marked fixed, 22nd August
item.description:
I previously reported serious overgrowth from the playing fields obstructing the public footpath at this location. I have now been informed that the issue has been fixed. It has not been fixed. The vegetation is still significantly encroaching onto the pavement and pedestrians are still being forced towards the edge of the kerb and the live road in order to get past. This is particularly dangerous for parents with young children, people using pushchairs or wheelchairs, and anyone with limited mobility. Please reopen/investigate this issue and arrange for the vegetation to be properly cut back so that the full usable width of the public footpath is restored. I would also ask that the issue is not marked as resolved again until the obstruction has actually been removed. This is a recurring problem at this location and should ideally be included in a regular maintenance schedule rather than being allowed to reach this condition each year.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Swingate Lane, Plumstead

item.title: Overgrown vegetation on Council-owned land – Avenue Road Car Park, 22nd August
item.description:
There is a substantial area of weeds and vegetation growing along the boundary of Avenue Road car park. The vegetation is growing underneath and through the boundary fence and spreading into the adjoining private rear access alley. I am not asking the Council to clear the private alley. I have already cleared the vegetation from the alley myself and continue to do so regularly. However, because of the amount of vegetation growing on the car park side of the fence, it continues to grow back and encroach into the alley. Please note that the last photograph is of the private alley was taken not long after I had already cleared the alley, so they do not show the full extent of the problem, but show the weeds growing back already. The vegetation has already started growing back from the car park side. I would therefore be grateful if the weeds and vegetation on the car park side of the boundary could be cut back and cleared. This would prevent it continually spreading back into the private alley, which I will continue to maintain myself. Thank you.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Blackthorn Grove, Blendon, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
